description: Core capabilities for the main window. The window is navigated to the Rust core's loopback URL (http://127.0.0.1:<os-assigned-port>), so the app commands (erase_all_data / quit_app /notify_still_recording) must be granted to that remote origin as well as the local bundle. Only 127.0.0.1 is granted; the shell never navigates to localhost. (Reveal folder is not here — it goes through the core's HTTP API, not Tauri IPC.)
